name: Towne Crossing Shopping Center
summary: Towne Crossing Shopping Center is a community retail destination in Mesquite, TX, managed by Phillips Edison & Company. With a 4.2-star rating and convenient location on Gus Thomasson Road, it serves as a neighborhood hub for everyday shopping needs.
demographics: Towne Crossing Shopping Center serves the Mesquite, TX community, drawing primarily from middle-income families and working professionals in the eastern Dallas metropolitan area. The trade area encompasses a diverse demographic mix with a significant proportion of households earning between $40,000-$75,000 annually, including young families with children and established homeowners. Shoppers in this area typically prioritize convenience and value, seeking everyday necessities and family-oriented retail options. The center attracts regular weekly visitors for grocery shopping and routine errands, with peak traffic during evenings and weekends when working residents have time for household shopping trips.
description: Towne Crossing Shopping Center is a well-established community retail destination located at 3600 Gus Thomasson Road in Mesquite, Texas, serving the eastern Dallas metropolitan area. Managed by Phillips Edison & Company, a nationally recognized shopping center REIT specializing in grocery-anchored properties, this center provides essential retail and services to the local community. The property maintains strong visibility and accessibility along Gus Thomasson Road, a major thoroughfare connecting residential neighborhoods throughout Mesquite. With a solid 4.2-star rating from over 2,100 reviews, Towne Crossing has built a reputation as a reliable shopping destination for everyday needs. The center operates with convenient hours from 9:00 AM to 8:00 PM, accommodating the schedules of working families and professionals in the area. As part of Phillips Edison's portfolio of neighborhood shopping centers, Towne Crossing exemplifies the company's focus on creating community gathering places anchored by necessity-based retailers that serve the daily needs of local residents.
